perspective: I am looking for a children’s movie for my little brother because I’m babysitting him tonight. I said hi and explained this. The recommender greeted me: “Hi happy new year.” I said “Happy New Year.” The recommender asked if I’d seen *The Secret Life of Pets* (2016). I told them I’m not really a fan; I liked the first half hour but then thought it got a little weird. The recommender then asked if I’d seen *Minions* (2015) and said those movies are hilarious. I have not yet responded to that.
